::: {.chapter-opening}
<span>Abstract</span>

Only a minimum of cosmology is needed: Hubble's law and the Friedmann equation, which reads as energy conservation (by analogy with lectures 1–2). The age of the Universe and distances through quadratures, root finding, fitting the Hubble diagram. A simple stiff problem: relaxation to equilibrium that the expansion «freezes» — explicit and implicit methods.

Chapter in preparation.
